parts.zh: 周二，救援人员在Brooklyn一处建筑工地发生坍塌后将一名男子救至安全地带
M: 好的。那让我先问问您的公司成立多久了
W: 我的祖父母在1955年创办了这家公司
M: 他们为什么决定在Bucharest开一家家具厂呢？
W: 那时候正值建筑热潮
M: 你们现在还是只做木制家具吗？
W: 没错。这是我们擅长的
M: 所有的木材都是本地的吗？
W: 是的。我们百分之百的原材料都来自Romania
M: 您能概括一下公司是如何发展壮大的吗？你们面临过哪些主要的挑战和机遇？

items.stem: What happened at a construction site in Brooklyn on Tuesday?

choices.text: A man was pulled to safety after a building collapse.
choices.zh: 一名男子在建筑物倒塌后被救至安全地带。

choices.text: A beam about ten feet long collapsed to the ground.
choices.zh: 一根约十英尺长的横梁坍塌到地面。

choices.text: A rescue worker got trapped in the basement.
choices.zh: 一名救援人员被困在地下室。

choices.text: A deserted 100-year-old building caught fire.
choices.zh: 一栋废弃的百年建筑着火了。

items.stem: What does the report say about the "non-worker civilian"?

choices.text: He suffered a fatal injury in an accident.
choices.zh: 他在一次事故中遭受致命伤害。

choices.text: He once served in a fire department.
choices.zh: 他曾在消防部门服役。

choices.text: He was collecting building materials.
choices.zh: 他正在收集建筑材料。

choices.text: He moved into his neighbor's old house.
choices.zh: 他搬进了邻居的旧房子。

items.stem: What does the organization National Numeracy aim to do?

choices.text: Improve the maths skills of high school teachers.
choices.zh: 提高高中教师的数学技能。

choices.text: Change British people's negative view of maths.
choices.zh: 改变英国人对数学的负面看法。

choices.text: Help British people understand their paychecks.
choices.zh: 帮助英国人理解他们的工资单。

choices.text: Launch a campaign to promote maths teaching.
choices.zh: 发起一项推广数学教学的运动。

items.stem: What is vital according to the chief executive of National Numeracy?

choices.text: Children take maths courses at an earlier age.
choices.zh: 儿童在更早的年龄学习数学课程。

choices.text: The public sees the value of maths in their life.
choices.zh: 公众看到数学在他们生活中的价值。

choices.text: British people know how to do elementary calculations.
choices.zh: 英国人知道如何进行基本计算。

choices.text: Primary school teachers understand basic maths concepts.
choices.zh: 小学教师理解基本的数学概念。

items.stem: What does the report say about the Dutch king?

choices.text: He owns a fleet of aircraft.
choices.zh: 他拥有一支飞机机队。

choices.text: He is learning to be a pilot.
choices.zh: 他正在学习成为一名飞行员。

choices.text: He regards his royal duties as a burden.
choices.zh: 他把王室职责视为负担。

choices.text: He held a part-time job for over 20 years.
choices.zh: 他做了一份兼职工作超过20年。

items.stem: Why does the king say he likes flying?

choices.text: He can demonstrate his superior piloting skills.
choices.zh: 他可以展示自己高超的驾驶技术。

choices.text: He can change his focus of attention and relax.
choices.zh: 他可以转移注意力焦点并放松。

choices.text: He can show his difference from other royalty.
choices.zh: 他可以显示自己与其他王室成员的不同。

choices.text: He can come into closer contact with his people.
choices.zh: 他可以与民众有更密切的接触。

items.stem: What does the king say about passengers at the airport?

choices.text: They enjoyed his company.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢有他陪伴。

choices.text: They liked him in his uniform.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢他穿制服的样子。

choices.text: They rarely recognised him.
choices.zh: 他们很少认出他来。

choices.text: They were surprised to see him.
choices.zh: 他们看到他感到惊讶。

items.stem: Why did Semenov's grandparents start a furniture plant in Bucharest?

choices.text: They were skilled carpenters themselves.
choices.zh: 他们自己就是熟练的木匠。

choices.text: It didn't need much capital to start with.
choices.zh: 起步不需要太多资金。

choices.text: Wood supply was plentiful in Romania.
choices.zh: 罗马尼亚木材供应充足。

choices.text: They saw a business opportunity there.
choices.zh: 他们看到了那里的商机。

items.stem: What was Semenov's grandfather trying to do?

choices.text: Provide quality furniture at affordable prices.
choices.zh: 以实惠的价格提供优质家具。

choices.text: Attract foreign investment to expand business.
choices.zh: 吸引外国投资以扩大业务。

choices.text: Enlarge their company by hiring more workers.
choices.zh: 通过雇用更多工人来扩大公司规模。

choices.text: Open some more branch companies in Germany.
choices.zh: 在德国开设更多分公司。

items.stem: What does Semenov say about her company's raw materials?

choices.text: They are from her hometown.
choices.zh: 它们来自她的家乡。

choices.text: They are imported from Germany.
choices.zh: 它们从德国进口。

choices.text: They all come from Romania.
choices.zh: 它们全部来自罗马尼亚。

choices.text: They come from all over the continent.
choices.zh: 它们来自整个欧洲大陆。

items.stem: Where does Semenov's company sell their products?

choices.text: All across Europe.
choices.zh: 遍布整个欧洲。

choices.text: Throughout the world.
choices.zh: 遍布全世界。

choices.text: Mostly in Bucharest.
choices.zh: 主要在布加勒斯特。

choices.text: In Romania only.
choices.zh: 仅在罗马尼亚。

items.stem: What does the man invite the woman to do this weekend?

choices.text: Go to a concert with him and his girlfriend.
choices.zh: 和他及他的女朋友一起去听音乐会。

choices.text: Try out a new restaurant together in town.
choices.zh: 一起尝试镇上的一家新餐厅。

choices.text: Go with him to choose a pearl for Susan.
choices.zh: 和他一起去为Susan挑选一颗珍珠。

choices.text: Attend the opening of a local restaurant.
choices.zh: 参加当地一家餐厅的开业活动。

items.stem: What does the man say about (614) Magazine?

choices.text: It is sponsored by local restaurants.
choices.zh: 它由当地餐厅赞助。

choices.text: It specializes in food advertizing.
choices.zh: 它专门从事食品广告。

choices.text: It is especially popular with the young.
choices.zh: 它特别受年轻人欢迎。

choices.text: It provides information on local events.
choices.zh: 它提供当地活动的信息。

items.stem: What does the man usually do with Susan during_____

choices.text: They design a special set of menus for themselves.
choices.zh: 他们为自己设计一套特别的菜单。

choices.text: They treat themselves to various entertainments.
choices.zh: 他们用各种娱乐活动款待自己。

choices.text: They go to eat at different stylish restaurants.
choices.zh: 他们去不同的时尚餐厅就餐。

choices.text: They participate in a variety of social events.
choices.zh: 他们参加各种社交活动。

items.stem: Why does the man say the woman is in luck?

choices.text: More restaurants will join Restaurant Week.
choices.zh: 更多餐厅将加入Restaurant Week。

choices.text: This year's Restaurant Week will start soon.
choices.zh: 今年的Restaurant Week很快就要开始了。

choices.text: Bigger discounts will be offered this Restaurant Week.
choices.zh: 这次Restaurant Week将提供更大的折扣。

choices.text: More types of food will be served this Restaurant Week.
choices.zh: 这次Restaurant Week将提供更多种类的食物。

items.stem: What is the best way to get children to eat vegetables according to a recent study?

choices.text: Rewarding them for eating vegetables.
choices.zh: 奖励他们吃蔬菜。

choices.text: Exposing them to vegetables repeatedly.
choices.zh: 让他们反复接触蔬菜。

choices.text: Improving the taste of vegetable dishes for them.
choices.zh: 为他们改善蔬菜菜肴的味道。

choices.text: Explaining the benefits of eating vegetables to them.
choices.zh: 向他们解释吃蔬菜的好处。

items.stem: What did the researchers find about carrots?

choices.text: They were disliked most by children.
choices.zh: 它们最不受儿童喜欢。

choices.text: They were considered most nutritious.
choices.zh: 它们被认为最有营养。

choices.text: They were least used in Belgian cooking.
choices.zh: 它们在比利时烹饪中使用最少。

choices.text: They were essential to children's health.
choices.zh: 它们对儿童健康至关重要。

items.stem: What does the result of this research show?

choices.text: Vegetables differ in their nutritional value.
choices.zh: 蔬菜的营养价值各不相同。

choices.text: Children's eating habits can be changed.
choices.zh: 儿童的饮食习惯是可以改变的。

choices.text: Parents watch closely what children eat.
choices.zh: 家长密切关注儿童吃什么。

choices.text: Children's choices of food vary greatly.
choices.zh: 儿童对食物的选择差异很大。

items.stem: What does the passage say may be unknown to many people?

choices.text: Space exploration has serious consequences.
choices.zh: 太空探索有严重后果。

choices.text: India has many space exploration programs.
choices.zh: 印度有许多太空探索项目。

choices.text: There is quite a lot to learn about the moon.
choices.zh: 关于月球有相当多的东西需要了解。

choices.text: A lot of garbage has been left on the moon.
choices.zh: 月球上留下了大量垃圾。

items.stem: Why has a lot of equipment been left on the moon?

choices.text: It is costly to bring back.
choices.zh: 带回来成本高昂。

choices.text: It is risky to destroy.
choices.zh: 销毁有风险。

choices.text: It is of no use on Earth.
choices.zh: 它在地球上没有用处。

choices.text: It is damaged by radiation.
choices.zh: 它被辐射损坏了。

items.stem: What can researchers do with the garbage on the moon?

choices.text: Record details of space exploration.
choices.zh: 记录太空探索的细节。

choices.text: Monitor the change of lunar weather.
choices.zh: 监测月球天气的变化。

choices.text: Study the effect of radiation and vacuum on its materials.
choices.zh: 研究辐射和真空对其材料的影响。

choices.text: Explore the possibility of human settlement on the moon.
choices.zh: 探索人类在月球上定居的可能性。

items.stem: What does the passage say about email?

choices.text: It is likely to remain a means of business communication.
choices.zh: 它可能会继续作为商务沟通的一种方式。

choices.text: It is likely to be a competitor of various messaging apps.
choices.zh: 它可能会成为各种消息应用的竞争对手。

choices.text: It will gradually be replaced by social media.
choices.zh: 它将逐渐被社交媒体取代。

choices.text: It will have to be governed by specific rules.
choices.zh: 它将必须受特定规则约束。

items.stem: What should one do upon receiving a personalized email?

choices.text: Save the message in their file.
choices.zh: 将邮件保存在文件中。

choices.text: Make a timely response.
choices.zh: 及时作出回复。

choices.text: Examine the information carefully.
choices.zh: 仔细审查信息。

choices.text: See if any action needs to be taken.
choices.zh: 看是否需要采取任何行动。

items.stem: What does the passage say about a mass email?

choices.text: It is to be passed on.
choices.zh: 它应该被转发。

choices.text: It is mostly junk.
choices.zh: 它大多是垃圾邮件。

choices.text: It requires no reply.
choices.zh: 它不需要回复。

choices.text: It causes no concern.
choices.zh: 它不会引起关注。

items.stem: What should one do when writing a business email?

choices.text: Make it as short as possible.
choices.zh: 尽可能使其简短。

choices.text: Use simple and clear language.
choices.zh: 使用简单明了的语言。

choices.text: Adopt an informal style of writing.
choices.zh: 采用非正式的写作风格。

choices.text: Avoid using capitals for emphasis.
choices.zh: 避免使用大写字母来强调。
